rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for creativity, especially when discussing fresh ideas or designs.

example.english: This ad design shows a lot of creativity.
example.traditional: 呢個廣告設計好有創意。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 cit3 gai3 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress the ability or capacity to create something new, rather than a particular idea.

example.english: Children can develop creativity by learning to draw.
example.traditional: 小朋友學畫畫，可以培養創造力。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 waa2 waa2 ho2 ji5 pui4 joeng5 cong3 zou6 lik6
